Note that ".xml" files will be parsed as XML content; all other kinds

items.source: Exposes the underlying GroovyBeanDefinitionReader for convenient access to the loadBeanDefinition methods on it as well as the ability to specify an inline Groovy bean definition closure.
items.translation: 暴露底层的GroovyBeanDefinitionReader，以便方便地访问其上的loadBeanDefinition方法，以及指定内联 Groovy bean definition 闭包的能力。

items.source: Load bean definitions from the given Groovy scripts or XML files.
items.translation: 从给定的 Groovy 脚本或 XML 文件中加载 Bean 定义。

items.source: This application context also understands XML bean definition files, allowing for seamless mixing and matching with Groovy bean definition files. ".xml" files will be parsed as XML content; all other kinds of resources will be parsed as Groovy scripts.
items.translation: 此应用程序上下文也理解 XML Bean 定义文件，允许与 Groovy Bean 定义文件无缝混合使用。".xml" 文件将作为 XML 内容解析；所有其他类型的资源将作为 Groovy 脚本解析。
